subject: Next steps for procurement intake and payment path (PO vs card / marketplace)
messages:
From: Samantha Reed <s.reed@acmeanalytics.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor intake + procurement path questions

Neha / Ben — thanks again for the demo earlier today. We had a quick internal sync and want to move forward with a procurement intake, but a few questions before we kick off our vendor portal request:  

- We've attached our standard vendor intake form (acme_vendor_intake_form.pdf). Can you confirm which documents you typically require to complete vendor setup? (W-9 vs W-8, banking details, vendor packet)  
- Our Procurement team prefers PO-first, but Finance can consider corporate card for small pilot purchases. Does Redwood accept PO invoicing, credit card, and marketplace (AWS Marketplace) purchases?  
- Timeline: from our side, how long does it typically take to be fully billable once paperwork is submitted?

Also looping in our AP inbox (accounts.payable@acmeanalytics.com) for banking details & remit info. If you can send a single vendor packet we can attach to our portal request, that would help.

Thanks — Samantha
Samantha Reed
Head of Product Finance, Acme Analytics

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Reed <s.reed@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2027 09:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor intake + procurement path questions

Samantha — great to hear you want to proceed. Recap + next steps below. Thanks for the intake form — I attached our Redwood vendor packet as a single PDF to simplify your portal submission. (redwood_vendor_packet_neha.pdf)

Recap from our side:
- Required docs to complete vendor setup: signed vendor packet (attached), Redwood W-9 (US entities) or W-8 (non-US entities) as applicable, and bank remit instructions. We can provide a copy of our W-9 right away.
- Payment methods supported: PO invoicing (Net 30 default), corporate card (Amex/Visa) for ad-hoc charges, and yes — we are listed on AWS Marketplace. If you plan to procure via Marketplace we can provide the SKU and buyer instructions.
- Typical onboarding timeline: 1–2 business days to validate paperwork on our side; AP approval timelines vary. If you submit everything at once (packet + W-9 + bank info) expect invoice-ready status within ~3 business days.

Action items:
1) Samantha / AP to confirm preferred payment path: "PO" or "Card" or "Marketplace" and provide AP contact (name, email, remit instructions).  
2) I will send our W-9 and planning guide + a DocuSign for the vendor packet if you prefer signed signatures.  
3) Ben (cc) will confirm invoicing email & billing contact on Redwood’s end.

Attachments: redwood_vendor_packet_neha.pdf (vendor packet, SOW template, standard terms), will follow up with W-9.

If helpful, I can also run through the vendor portal submission with your procurement person on a short call — happy to schedule 20 minutes.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

From: AP Team <accounts.payable@acmeanalytics.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Reed <s.reed@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Dec 2027 10:44:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor intake + procurement path questions

Neha — thanks for the packet. We plan to route via PO for the initial pilot. Attaching our AP contact CSV and remit template (acme_ap_contact.csv). A couple quick clarifications:

- Remit address: will Redwood accept remit-to via EFT/ACH? We have ACH enabled and prefer that where possible.
- Billing contact: please confirm the email to which we should send POs and where invoices should be directed (we typically send POs to vendors@domain and invoices to ar@domain).  

We are hoping to get the vendor into our portal by EOD next Wednesday. How long after that before Redwood can accept a first PO?

Regards,
Acme AP Team

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: AP Team <accounts.payable@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Samantha Reed <s.reed@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2027 09:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor intake + procurement path questions

Thanks — received the AP contact file. Quick answers and final steps:  

- Yes, we accept EFT/ACH (preferred) and can provide Redwood's banking remit info once you confirm the vendor record is created in your portal.
- Please route POs to billing@redwood.com and invoices to invoices@redwood.com. Our finance team (Ben Carter) will monitor the mailbox for the PO and kick off invoice reconciliation.
- Timeline: once the vendor record is active in your portal we can accept a PO immediately; payment terms per your PO will apply (we invoice Net 30 unless you request otherwise). Typical first-PO acceptance is same business day after validation on our side.

Next steps I will take: send W-9 to this thread, and a DocuSign link for an executed vendor packet (https://www.docusign.com/link/ABC123-redwood-acme-onboard). Ben will confirm billing contact.

If you’d like a short 15–20 minute handoff with our onboarding specialist, tell me availability and we’ll book.

Best —
Neha
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

--
Neha Kapoor
